glomeris llm-check — Test the configured LLM endpoint, credential and model.

usage: glomeris llm-check [--json]

Advisory — proposes, never executes.

Sends one request containing two fixed words and reports what came back. It
runs no detectors, reads no project roots, collects no evidence and consults
no policy, so it describes nothing about this machine to the provider. It
never prints your credential. Use it to tell a wrong address apart from a
wrong key apart from a wrong model name.

Options
  --json
      Print an LlmCheckReport as JSON on stdout.

Examples
  glomeris llm-check
      Does my provider setup actually work?

Exit codes
  0   the provider answered and the reply was usable.
  1   the check ran and did not pass. The report is printed first — it
      names which of the endpoint, credential or model to look at.
  2   nothing was sent and there is no report: no provider configured, a
      base URL that cannot work, or an unrecognized argument.
  Run `glomeris help exit-codes` for the codes shared by every command.

See also: llm-plan
